```sql
WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption,
        COUNT(*) AS num_consumption
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE Date = '201301'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM segment_consumption
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM segment_consumption
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_avg_min AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM segment_min
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_avg_lam AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM segment_avg
    WHERE Segment = 'LAM'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_avg_kam AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM segment_avg
    WHERE Segment = 'KAM'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_avg_sme AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM segment_avg
    WHERE Segment = 'SME'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_avg_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.avg_consumption - s2.avg_consumption AS diff_sme_lam,
        s2.avg_consumption - s3.avg_consumption AS diff_lam_kam,
        s3.avg_consumption - s4.avg_consumption AS diff_kam_sme
    FROM segment_avg s1, segment_avg s2, segment_avg s3, segment_avg s4
    WHERE s1.segment = s2.segment = s3.segment = s4.segment
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN s1.segment = 'SME' AND s2.segment = 'LAM' THEN s1.avg_consumption - s2.avg_consumption
        WHEN s1.segment = 'LAM' AND s2.segment = 'KAM' THEN s2.avg_consumption - s3.avg_consumption
        WHEN s1.segment = 'KAM' AND s2.segment = 'SME' THEN s3.avg_consumption - s4.avg_consumption
    END AS annual_avg_diff
FROM segment_avg_diff
```

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_fifa_api_id = ta.team_fifa_api_id
JOIN Player p ON t.team_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', ta.date) = '2012'
  AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (
    SELECT SUM(buildUpPlayPassing)
    FROM Team_Attributes ta2
    WHERE ta2.team_fifa_api_id = ta.team_fifa_api_id
      AND ta2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND COUNT(ta2.buildUpPlayPassing) > 0
GROUP BY t.team_long_name
HAVING COUNT(ta2.buildUpPlayPassing) > 0
ORDER BY t.team_long_name

```sql
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id
JOIN Country c ON p.player_fifa_api_id = c.id
WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND p.birthday > '1990';
```

FROM results r
JOIN races r2 ON r.raceId = r2.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructors c ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId

SELECT s.full_name, MAX(s.height_cm) as tallest_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN superpower sp ON s.id = sp.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON hp.hero_id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
JOIN colour c ON ha.eye_colour_id = c.id
JOIN gender g ON ha.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON ha.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN race r ON ha.race_id = r.id
JOIN alignment a ON ha.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.full_name DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM colour c
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = c.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = sp.id
JOIN superhero s ON s.id = hp.hero_id

SELECT s.school_name, s.doc_type
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.CharterSchool = 0 AND f.FundingType = 'LOCALLY_FUNDING'
AND (s.Enrollment (K-12) - s.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) > (
    SELECT AVG(Enrollment (K-12) - Enrollment (Ages 5-17))
    FROM frpm f2
    WHERE f2.CharterSchool = 0 AND f2.FundingType = 'LOCALLY_FUNDING'
)
ORDER BY s.school_name
